title: Because of Me: The Inflection of 'miatt'

sections.content:
The postposition *miatt* expresses cause or fault ('because of / due to'). When combined with personal suffixes:
- **miattam** (because of me / on my account)
- **miattad** (because of you)
- **miatta** (because of him/her)
- **miattunk** (because of us)
- **miattatok** (because of you pl.)
- **miattuk** (because of them)

Crucial in apologies and reassurance: *Ne aggódj miattam!* (Don't worry about me!), *Ne haragudj, miattam késtünk el!* (Don't be mad, we were late because of me!).

items.spanish: Ne aggódj miattam, már sokkal jobban érzem magam!
items.english: Don't worry on my account, I feel much better already!

items.spanish: Nem miattad történt a félreértés, ne hibáztasd magad!
items.english: The misunderstanding did not happen because of you, don't blame yourself!

items.spanish: A dugó miatt késtünk, nem miattuk.
items.english: We were late because of the traffic jam, not because of them.
